title: Successor step of an abstract run
statement: For any register program $A$, oracle function $o$, input $x$, configuration $a$, and natural number $n$, running for $n+1$ steps from $a$ gives the same configuration as first taking one abstract step from $a$ and then running for $n$ more steps.
